historical_context.time_period: Present condition after the imperial rupture; exact local calendar and proper names remain unassigned pending Weksa language work.
historical_context.location: A descriptive river-cleft Matriarch archive grove in the unconquered Airawa Home Continent, outside direct imperial topology.
historical_context.summary: A declining elder Matriarch is preparing to transfer archive and gestation authority to a rooted juvenile. During an ordinary witness rehearsal, threadwings return an omitted shelter grievance that forces the local succession procedure to prove whether memory continuity can preserve dissent.

public_facts.text: Matriarchs store communal memory, gestate Airawa young, and mediate multispecies obligations.
A successor's biological maturity does not grant archive, gestation-ranking, or treaty authority; recognition requires independent root, route, and debt witnesses.
Threadwing sensory fibers can carry route testimony that lattice ants inspect as local material evidence.
Candle fungal roads can reconstruct material traffic and withhold recognition by dimming routes.
An omitted party can darken the succession through two independent witness channels, suspending disputed authority while preserving the candidate's bodily autonomy.

ambient_pressures.text: Airawa households need gestation access before a narrowing biological window, so delay has reproductive and political cost.
The elder Matriarch controls inherited memory and may have incentives to omit a debt that would stain her continuity.
Native networks accept slow heterogeneous witness because one fast shared channel can be infected or coerced by the Biological Memetic Engine.

groups.label: River-cleft archive-grove succession quorum
institutional_logic: Transfer deep archive, gestation ranking, and treaty voice only when root memory, mobile route testimony, and a materially performed debt can be inspected independently.
material_incentives: Keep roads and couriers recognizing the grove
internal_shames: Letting one lineage explain every witness
Erasing a creditor to save time
prestige_markers: A debt preserved against the winner
A route that still carries the verdict
A joint-keeper whose cords remain readable under pressure
emotional_display_norms: Pressure is made visible through route light, cord placement, root openness, basket posture, and witness withdrawal before anyone trusts a speech.
trust_defaults: Trusts convergence across differently embodied channels more than unanimity inside one network.

groups.label: Elder and juvenile Matriarch continuity
institutional_logic: Transfer enough memory and obligation to preserve the grove without letting inheritance erase the parties who made the archive possible.
internal_virtues: Obligations paid from the successor's own reserves
emotional_display_norms: Trees express insistence and refusal through root pressure, bark light, sugar flow, shelter state, chemical signals, and selective access.
trust_defaults: Trusts long root memory but requires mobile and material correction when succession is disputed.

groups.label: Threadwing route flock and lattice-ant auditors
institutional_logic: Carry claims beyond root control and make their contact history locally inspectable.
internal_shames: Sold testimony hidden from other buyers
A courier route made captive to one grove
prestige_markers: A lattice that exposes its own chain
A withdrawal every neighbor can read
emotional_display_norms: Threadwings use vane spread, landing, silence, and departure; ants use lattice density, glyphs, and refusal to sample.
trust_defaults: Trusts clean custody and paid care more than a grove's claim to ancestral innocence.

groups.label: Airawa households awaiting gestation access
institutional_logic: Keep local continuity alive by securing timely gestation while remaining bound to ecological partners whose routes and memory make future children viable.
material_incentives: Recognition before the biological window closes
internal_shames: Winning birth access by silencing another species
Making private lineage need masquerade as grove authority
prestige_markers: A child admitted into many living obligations
taboo_triggers: Archive edits that reorder contributor standing
A lost season treated as an abstract procedural cost
emotional_display_norms: Urgency appears in talon rhythm, basket placement, plate-seam glow, and withdrawal of material support.
trust_defaults: Trusts the quorum while it visibly bears the same delay it imposes.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A clean succession is suspicious when every agreeing witness shares the elder's transmission path.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prompt characters to ask which body carried a memory and what appetite could make that body disagree.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Every additional check can protect public authority and still close a real gestation window.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep delay embodied in pulsing hollows, spent graft tissue, nutrient baskets, and households leaving.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A successor seated without route testimony may rule locally while neighboring roads and couriers refuse to carry her authority.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Show political muteness through dark roads, empty roosts, and a treaty scent with no carrier.

observer_read: A distant route grievance delaying local births
target_self_read: Creditors preserving the condition that makes grove authority portable
misread_patterns: Treats nonverbal withdrawal as absence rather than verdict
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let household impatience remain morally intelligible while showing the jurisdiction it cannot replace.

observer_read: Shallow recent residue challenging deep memory
target_self_read: Independent correction for a rooted archive with power to omit
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the elder's coercion rooted in timescale and archive control instead of human courtroom villainy.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A temporary Airawa office that separates witness media, names sources through contract dress, translates signals, and invokes procedures without owning the verdict.
failure_modes: Allowing lineage need to become jurisdiction

role_pressure_fields.summary: A biologically mature young Matriarch seeking archive and gestation authority while still dependent on witnesses she cannot command.
obligations: Keep body autonomy distinct from public authority
failure_modes: Accepting local acclaim as complete recognition

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa household under a real reproductive deadline whose need can expose procedural cruelty or be used to capture succession.
obligations: Accept route and archive obligations inherited by future young
failure_modes: Silencing a creditor to save the season

known_context.text: The keeper knows the local procedure, witness media, visible contract marks, current gestation pressure, and signals presented on the terrace.

beliefs.text: The keeper believes separate appetites make forgery harder, even when they make justice slower.

misreads.text: The keeper may overvalue clean procedure when households are bearing an irreversible biological cost.

must_not_know.text: The keeper must not know whether the elder truly promised the shelter or privately intends to coerce the juvenile; only presented signals and evidence are available.

known_context.text: The elder controls her transmitted archive braid, remembers local obligations, and perceives root, fungal, chemical, and partner signals within the grove.

beliefs.text: The elder treats unsourced or foreign memory as contamination risk and her own continuity as necessary to the grove.

misreads.text: The elder may treat the depth and age of her archive as proof that a recent mobile witness is mistaken.

must_not_know.text: The elder must not automatically know what a distant courier experienced beyond the local network or what ants infer before their lattice reports it.

known_context.text: The juvenile knows the bounded memories transferred into her, current root pressure, shelter and sugar costs, and testimony physically presented to her roots.

beliefs.text: The juvenile initially trusts elder-root continuity but can learn that preserving a sourced accusation is different from absorbing it as truth.

misreads.text: The juvenile may classify contradiction as contamination because inherited memory and immune politics share a substrate.

must_not_know.text: The juvenile must not retrieve an omitted debt from a universal planetary mind; no such authority exists.

author_only_boundaries.text: The river-cleft grove, the omitted shelter grievance, the joint-keeper in this scene, and every branch outcome are fixture-local dramatization, not established historical events.
Descriptive English labels are translation handles. The fixture does not settle culture-specific Weksa names, exact calendar terms, or a universal Matriarch succession vocabulary.

The witnessed-succession elaboration belongs to native Matriarch archive polities and must not be generalized to the Airawa Empire, Sa'ueia, reefs, roads, or all Zyphos nations without new source work.

open_questions.question: How long is a normal Airawa gestation admission window, and which ecological signals define its closing?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses coarse urgency bands and visible hollow pulses so it does not invent a universal calendar.

open_questions.question: Which contracted pollinator lineages carry Airawa gametes in this region?
open_questions.notes: Threadwings serve only as route witnesses here; the fixture does not assign them Airawa gamete transport.

open_questions.question: How frequently do native Matriarch polities use this exact three-channel procedure versus local variants?
open_questions.notes: The lore patch defines the common witnessed shape while leaving regional media and offices variable.
